title: Ravin bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 86a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.86a.4): “But did not Ravin bar Abba say — and some say Rabbi Avin bar Sheva…” Hyman quotes Dikdukei Soferim: Rabbi Avin bar Sheva, and some say Rabbi Avin bar Rav Sheva.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli and [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=186&lang=en) give Ravin bar Abba and Rabbi Avin bar Sheva as alternate speakers. Hyman also reports the form Rabbi Avin bar Rav Sheva from Dikdukei Soferim.
